rows.jp: 「仕方ない。これをやろう」
rows.en: “Oh, fine. You can have this.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "No other way then, I'm giving you this."

rows.jp: 太一袋から、サンドイッチの包みを取り出す。
rows.en: I took a wrapped sandwich from the Taichi Bag.

ghs.en: From the Taichi Bag I take out the sandwich wraps.

rows.jp: 「これは？」
rows.en: “What's this?”

ghs.en: Miki: "These are...?"

rows.jp: 「神話で砂と魔女を挟んで食べたという言い伝えが……」
rows.en: “Legend says the ancients would put sand and a witch between two slices of bread...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The legend of how they are eaten sandwitched between sand and a witch has been retold for---"

rows.jp: 「サンドイッチですか」
rows.en: “A sandwich?”

ghs.en: Miki: "They're sandwiches are they?"

rows.jp: 機先を制された。
rows.en: She beat me to the punch.

ghs.en: Forestalled.

rows.jp: 「うぐー、そうだ！」
rows.en: “Ngh—yes, it is!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ngggh, you're right!"

rows.jp: 「怒られている……」
rows.en: “Why are you mad at me...?”

ghs.en: Miki: "I made you angry..."

rows.jp: 「やる！」
rows.en: “Take it!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Have'em!"

rows.jp: 「えっ、いいんですか？　先輩のごはんでは？」
rows.en: “What? Are you sure? Isn't this your lunch?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Eh, seriously? But what about your lunch, Senpai?"

rows.jp: 「俺はいくらでも調達できるし」
rows.en: “I can get as much food as I want.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I can scrounge up as many as I want."

rows.jp: 「……二人分はあるから、霧ちんと食べると良い」
rows.en: “...There's enough for two. Share it with Kiri-kins.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...there's enough for two, so do eat them with Kiri-chin."

rows.jp: 「ありがてぇのですが……その」
rows.en: “I'm mighty grateful, but... um...”

ghs.en: Miki: "I'm thanking ye... but..."

rows.jp: 「……さっき霧ちんをランチに誘ったら相手にもされなかったよ」
rows.en: “...I asked Kiri-kins to lunch earlier and she wouldn't give me the time of day.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...earlier I invited Kiri-chin to lunch, but let's just say I wasn't considered a possible partner."

rows.jp: 「うおー、この人は人類死滅してもまだ霧ちんいじりを……」
rows.en: “Whoa! Humanity goes extinct and you're still trying to mess with Kiri-kins...”

ghs.en: Miki: "Woooh, even with humanity annihilated this guy still goes and bullies Kiri-chin..."

rows.jp: 美希はわなわな震えた。
rows.en: Miki trembled.

ghs.en: Miki shook and trembled with fear.

rows.jp: 「人類が滅亡したところで、変わる俺ではなかった」
rows.en: “The extinction of mankind had failed to change me.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I wasn't among the ones that changed with the Fall of mankind."

rows.jp: モノローグ調で告げる。
rows.en: I said it like a voice-over.

ghs.en: So I proclaimed in the style of a monologue.

rows.jp: 「さすがヤングメン……」
rows.en: “That's our young man...”

ghs.en: Miki: "Totally a Young Man..."

rows.jp: 「ヤングアダルト候補生だ。間違えるなよ」
rows.en: “Young-adult-in-training. Don’t get it wrong.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Young Adult Cadet you mean. Make no mistake you!"

rows.jp: 「違いわからんです」
rows.en: “I don’t see the difference.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Don't get the difference."

rows.jp: 「ヤングアダルトというのは、酸いも甘いも知っている男の中の男。つまり俺の目指す理想の大人像」
rows.en: “A young adult is a man among men, seasoned in all life's sweetness and bitterness. In other words, my ideal of the perfect grown-up.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Young Adults are men among men who know both the bitter and the sweet by having had all kinds of experiences in life. In other words, it is the ideal image of an adult on which my aims are set."

rows.jp: 「そつなく仕事をこなし部下からは慕われ、上司でさえも萎縮してしまうスーパーエリート」
rows.en: “A super-elite who handles every job with effortless competence, earns the devotion of his subordinates, and intimidates even his superiors.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Loved by his subordinates and highly competent in work: a Super Elite that dwarfs even his superiors."

rows.jp: 「そして週末はビーチでのアバンチュールで都会の喧噪を忘れ、夜は書斎でバイロンの詩集を黙読しつつコニャックを楽しむわけだ」
rows.en: “Then, every weekend, he forgets the urban din in a beachside love affair; every night, he sits in his study, silently reading Byron over a glass of cognac.”

rows.jp: 「……少女に対してだけでなく、将来の自分にまで幻想持ってましたか」
rows.en: “...So girls aren’t the only thing you fantasize about. You do it with your future self too.”

ghs.en: Miki: "...so they're not just about girls, you have fantasies about your future self as well?"

rows.jp: 「そう誉めるなよミッキー」
rows.en: “Now, now. Don't flatter me, Mickey.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "That is excessively praiseful, Mickey."

rows.jp: 「ミッキーです。誉めてません」
rows.en: “Mickey here. And I wasn't.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Mickey here. I am not praising you."

rows.jp: 「ま、今はまだ候補生だからまだまだ蕾ではあるけどな」
rows.en: “Well, I'm still only a candidate. Still a bud, you might say.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well, for now I am still a cadet, ergo I am but a bud and nothing more."

rows.jp: 「花開いたら霧ちんもきっと俺にメロメロ……」
rows.en: “But once I bloom, Kiri-kins will be head over heels...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Once I blossom, surely even Kiri-chin shall fall madly in love..."

rows.jp: 「醜いアヒルの子はたいてい醜いまま大人になるんですよ～」
rows.en: “Most ugly ducklings just grow up ugly.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Ugly ducklings usually grow up to still be ugly you kno~w."

rows.jp: にこやかに言う。
rows.en: She said it with a bright smile.

ghs.en: So she says smilingly.

rows.jp: 「ひどいっ！」
rows.en: “Cruel!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Meanie!"

rows.jp: 泣き伏す。
rows.en: I collapsed in tears.

ghs.en: I break down crying.

rows.jp: 「だって生きるのに希望がいるんだもんっ」
rows.en: “But I need hope to liiive!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But I need that hope to live!"

rows.jp: 「よしよし、泣かないでください～」
rows.en: “There, there. Don't cry.”

ghs.en: Miki: "There, there, please don't cry～."

rows.jp: 「……とにかく、そのサンドイッチをミッキーの手作りと称して霧ちんに食べさせてやりなさい」
rows.en: “...Anyway. Tell Kiri-kins that Mickey made the sandwiches and get her to eat them.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...anyway, do say that you have made those sandwiches yourself, Mickey, so you can get Kiri-chin to eat them."

rows.jp: 「……あの、いただいておいてこんなこと言うのもナンですが」
rows.en: “...I know I shouldn't say this after accepting them, but...”

ghs.en: Miki: "...uhm, if I take them I will say that for sure, but..."

rows.jp: 「媚薬とか入ってないですよね？」
rows.en: “You didn't put an aphrodisiac in them, did you?”

ghs.en: Miki: "There's no aphrodisiac or anything in here is there?"

rows.jp: 気持ちよいほどに信頼されていなかった。
rows.en: The complete absence of trust was almost refreshing.

ghs.en: Distrusted to a quite pleasant level.
